reconstruction.assumptions: The only mathematical assumptions are ContDiff Real 2 f (C2 on the whole real line) and HasCompactSupport f (compact closure of the nonzero support). C2 supplies differentiability for deriv. No caller-supplied integrability, positivity, nonzero mass, density normalization, probabilistic law, convergence, or entropy certificate occurs.
reconstruction.conclusion: Conjunction of gamma-integrability of f^2, f^2 log(f^2), and (deriv f)^2; integrability of all three composed with S_n against mu_n for every natural n; scalar convergence atTop of each corresponding successor integral to its gamma integral; and scalar convergence of the successor expression B_(n+1)-A_(n+1) log(A_(n+1)) to B-A log(A). Integrable denotes actual Bochner integrability, and all six types of displayed integrals are Bochner integrals. The logarithmic integrand need not be nonnegative. The conclusion contains no inequality, quantitative rate, convergence of derivatives as functions, or quantified law-convergence claim.
reconstruction.constant_dependencies: The fixed numerical constants are the signs +1 and -1, mean 0, variance 1, exponent 2, and the successor offset 1. The dimension-dependent normalization is exactly 1/sqrt(n), with the stated zero convention, and the measure scaling is exactly inverse actual carrier cardinality in ENNReal. Integrals depend on f and on their displayed measure and dimension. There is no asserted rate constant, universal inequality constant, hidden parameter, or adjustable Gaussian variance.
reconstruction.domains: f and deriv f have domain and codomain Real. Real has its canonical Borel structure. n ranges over Nat including 0. Each finite observable has domain Fin n -> Bool with canonical finite measurable structure and real codomain; mu_n is a measure on that exact carrier. Gaussian observables are measured on Real. Cardinality scaling lies in ENNReal; signed sums, square roots, logarithms, integrals, entropy values, and limit values lie in Real. gamma is a probability Gaussian of mean 0 and variance NNReal 1.
reconstruction.objects: A real function f and its real derivative deriv f; the finite carriers Omega_n = Fin n -> Bool; scaled counting measures mu_n defined using their actual cardinalities; actual signed-sum maps S_n; the fixed Gaussian gamma = gaussianReal 0 1; the three observables f^2, f^2 log(f^2), and (deriv f)^2; their finite and Gaussian Bochner integrals and the displayed entropy expressions.
reconstruction.quantifiers: Universally quantify f : Real -> Real with proofs of C2 regularity and compact support. mu, S, and gamma are local definitions, not caller parameters. The finite integrability conjunction is universal in every n : Nat, including 0. Each of the four Tendsto conclusions is a limit of a sequence indexed by n : Nat atTop, with its finite measure and signed sum evaluated at the successor n+1 and with convergence into the real neighborhood filter of the specified Gaussian scalar. No rate, uniform quantifier, variable Gaussian parameter, or further certificate is quantified.
reconstruction.reconstructed_theorem_text:
For every real-valued function f on the real line that is C2 and has compact support, define, for each natural number n (including n = 0), the finite space Omega_n = {epsilon : Fin n -> Bool}, the measure mu_n = (card(Omega_n) : ENNReal)^(-1) times counting measure, and S_n(epsilon) = (sqrt(n : Real))^(-1) times sum over j : Fin n of (1 if epsilon(j) is true, and -1 otherwise). Let gamma = gaussianReal 0 1, the real Gaussian probability measure of mean 0 and variance 1, and let f' denote the real derivative deriv f.
The three real functions x -> f(x)^2, x -> f(x)^2 log(f(x)^2), and x -> f'(x)^2 are Bochner integrable against gamma. For every natural n, their compositions with S_n are Bochner integrable against mu_n.
Write A_n = integral over Omega_n of f(S_n(epsilon))^2 dmu_n, B_n = integral over Omega_n of f(S_n(epsilon))^2 log(f(S_n(epsilon))^2) dmu_n, and D_n = integral over Omega_n of f'(S_n(epsilon))^2 dmu_n. Write A = integral over Real of f(x)^2 dgamma, B = integral over Real of f(x)^2 log(f(x)^2) dgamma, and D = integral over Real of f'(x)^2 dgamma. As n tends to infinity through the natural numbers, A_(n+1) tends to A, B_(n+1) tends to B, D_(n+1) tends to D, and B_(n+1) - A_(n+1) log(A_(n+1)) tends to B - A log(A), all as scalar convergence in Real.
The inverse of zero is zero and the Fin 0 sum is empty, so S_0 = 0 on the singleton space Omega_0; the all-n integrability conclusion includes this case, while the limit sequences use n+1. Real.log is totalized with log(0) = 0, including at zeros of f and at zero mass A_n or A. No positivity, density normalization, integrability certificate, or limit certificate for f is an extra hypothesis.
reconstruction.scopes: mu_n uses inverse actual finite-carrier cardinality times counting measure; S_n uses the displayed sqrt(n) inverse and actual sum of Bool-selected +1/-1 values. All dimensions, including n=0, are covered only by the finite integrability assertion. At n=0 the carrier is a singleton, the sum is empty, inverse zero equals zero, and S_0 is zero. Limits use positive successor dimensions n+1. gamma remains the single fixed mean-zero variance-one Gaussian. Real.log(0)=0 makes f^2 log(f^2) zero at zeros of f and makes mass times log(mass) zero at zero mass; no exclusion or separate positivity assumption is imposed. All four limits are real scalar limits of the expressions literally displayed.
